name: Tonaki (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Tonaki village emblem in white: an outlined ring crossed by winged horizontal bars with a vertical bar.
history: Municipal flag of Tonaki, a village in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Tonaki village emblem — an outlined ring crossed by winged horizontal bars with a vertical bar
